threshold_validation.note: The bundled 2018_09_26_binary.tif contains 558,812 positive pixels and is reproduced by thresholding the probability raster at approximately 0.20, not 0.55. Every pixel with probability >= 0.55 (472,495) is inside that mask, but the mask adds 86,317 extra pixels with scores 0.20-0.55. The published pipeline report lists 473,772 predicted oil pixels, reproduced at probability >= 0.54546; exactly >= 0.55 on this raster measures 472,495 (floating-point rounding, about 0.3%).

display_decision: Stage 03 shows FOCUSED ROI previews cropped to the predicted-slick bounding box. Both visuals are re-derived from the REAL probability raster at the documented threshold 0.55 (full resolution, then downsampling). The bundled 2018_09_26_binary.tif was NOT used as the display source because its ~0.20 effective threshold conflicts with the documented 0.55 pipeline output. Full-scene 1500x754 previews remain available in this directory.

roi_crop.padding: 12% of the positive-mask bounding box, symmetric, clipped to the 5083x2555 scene edge
roi_crop.basis: bounding box of all pixels with probability >= 0.55 (472,495 pixels) at full resolution
roi_crop.note: Identical crop window used for the probability and binary ROI previews. 100% of the 472,495 positive mask pixels fall inside the crop.

previews.visualization: Single-channel warm-progressive LUT over a dark neutral base: dark = low slick score, increasingly warm/brighter = higher slick score. Values used as-is in [0,1]; no percentile remapping; aspect ratio preserved.

Background = warm off-white (#f6f3ec); predicted slick = muted amber (#8a5a1e). Binary at full resolution (>= 0.55) then nearest-neighbor downsampling; no smoothing, no interpolation of mask edges. 472,495 positive pixels, all contained in the crop.
Full-scene context view. Same visualization as the ROI preview. No percentile stretch.
Full-scene context view. Background = warm off-white (#f6f3ec); predicted slick = muted amber (#8a5a1e). 472,495 positive pixels.
